name: Rex Fleet: Stormwell Archive
developmentStatus: New RexPrompt production series initiated with a complete Issue 1 working production skeleton. Issue 1 title remains provisional until explicitly approved.
premise: Stormwell Archive is a mobile Fleet archival-science and forensic-reconstruction vessel. Its crews recover damaged records, rebuild obsolete systems, reconstruct provenance, compare divergent archives, test sensor claims, and certify what evidence can actually support after the Shattering fractured both infrastructure and information.
seriesQuestion: How does a civilization know that its history, maps, measurements, and agreements are what it thinks they are?
storyEngine: Each issue begins with a record, object, dataset, map, testimony, or institutional claim that matters operationally. The Stormwell team establishes physical custody and provenance, reconstructs the system that produced the evidence, separates raw observations from later interpretation, tests competing explanations, and ends with a bounded finding: what is supported, what is probable, what is contradicted, and what remains unknowable.
genre: Forensic science fiction about evidence, archival science, systems archaeology, metrology, and uncertainty.
canonPosition: Shared Rex Fleet visual and political canon applies wherever the series touches existing ships, institutions, regions, corridor physics, Crowns, Verge, or Shards.
Archivist Selene Stormwell retains her live Rex Fleet identity: precise, patient, evidence-first, and explicitly non-ceremonial in her archive practice.
Stormwell's older memorial and shrine associations may exist as public culture around the name and fixed Memory Vault, but the operational ship in this series is research infrastructure.

The Stormwell Archive does not own a single master truth. Worlds, fleets, civic bodies, Verge communities, and other institutions retain their own records; Stormwell provides methods, reconstruction, standards, and neutral evidentiary findings.
worldRules: Integrity is not truth. A perfectly authentic record can encode a mistaken interpretation, biased claim, obsolete calibration, or inherited assumption.
Corruption is not the only source of disagreement. Post-Shattering archives can diverge legitimately when isolated copies evolve independently.
A record's provenance includes the physical object, storage history, software, hardware, calibration, clock source, transformations, and institutional lineage needed to interpret it.
Derived products such as maps, summaries, histories, and models must remain distinguishable from the raw observations they descend from.
Uncertainty is allowed to survive the end of an issue. Operational decisions can be justified without pretending the underlying phenomenon is solved.
Lattice anomalies remain physical phenomena to be measured. Do not use them as magical explanations for any record discrepancy that can be explained by ordinary systems behavior.

shipIdentity.name: Stormwell Archive
shipIdentity.function: Mobile archival-science, forensic reconstruction, standards, and field-recovery vessel.
shipIdentity.hullUse: A large Fleet hull with former carrier-scale internal volume repurposed for evidence quarantine, restoration labs, reference hardware, metrology, secure compute, interview rooms, and survey/recovery craft.
shipIdentity.visual: Mature Fleet exterior language in blue, white, and restrained gold. Interior identity comes from labs, preserved machinery, sealed evidence movement, and side-by-side generations of technology rather than shrine imagery.

issueOne.case: Recovered Far Lantern telemetry appears to continue for twelve minutes after the survey cutter's destruction. Stormwell proves the apparent time anomaly is a timestamp-translation error, then discovers the deeper danger: an authentic inherited mapping model is suppressing real modern sensor data because it still applies a correction written for obsolete gravimeters.
issueOne.resolution: Harrow Fold is closed on evidence, not speculation. A controlled remeasurement confirms the shear while its underlying Lattice mechanism remains unresolved.
issueOne.nextCaseHook: Two independently authenticated descendants of the same agreement contain different Article Seven text.

productionRules: Scene not card: every page recipe must describe sequential action, causal movement, human performance, and the physical evidence being handled.
Minimize environmental text and screens. Use only lettering necessary to the story; provenance graphs and telemetry should read visually before they read verbally.
No shrine robes, lantern ceremonies, sacred-name iconography, cathedral archives, mystical memory effects, or floating text as the default Stormwell visual language.
No generic cyberpunk hologram clutter. Data has physical lineage and should often be represented through objects, instruments, cables, storage media, printed/sealed evidence, or restrained displays.
No revelation may skip the method that justifies it. If a conclusion matters, the reader should see the evidentiary step that earns it.
